tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind cards. Neutrals lean slightly olive toward the lime accent.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: step rows, inputs, empty progress segments.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and days; chart gridlines.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Active card outline (current week), input borders. 3:1 against surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and big numbers on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, subtitles, units next to a number.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Uppercase labels, axis labels, inactive tab labels. Still 4.5:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Grind lime. Fills only: primary buttons, progress, today ring, the active tab pill. Always put on-accent text on it.

tokens.name: accent-press
tokens.usage: Pressed / hover state of accent fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Lime used as text or an icon on surface (links, 'on target' ticks). Darkens in light theme to keep contrast.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for coach notes and highlighted rows. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring with 2px offset.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed, on target. Text and icons.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Slightly off target, missed but movable.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, plan check failures.

tokens.name: on-type
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any type-* fill. All type fills pass 4.5:1 with it.

tokens.name: type-easy
tokens.usage: Easy run fill: quick-add tiles, workout tag squares.

tokens.name: type-easy-mark
tokens.usage: Easy run dots, bars and small marks on bg or surface.

tokens.name: type-tempo
tokens.usage: Tempo / threshold run fill.

tokens.name: type-tempo-mark
tokens.usage: Tempo dots and marks.

tokens.name: type-intervals
tokens.usage: Intervals / speed fill.

tokens.name: type-intervals-mark
tokens.usage: Intervals dots and marks.

tokens.name: type-hills
tokens.usage: Hill session fill.

tokens.name: type-hills-mark
tokens.usage: Hills dots and marks.

tokens.name: type-long
tokens.usage: Long run fill.

tokens.name: type-long-mark
tokens.usage: Long run dots and marks.

tokens.name: type-race
tokens.usage: Race day and time trials fill.

tokens.name: type-race-mark
tokens.usage: Race dots and marks.

tokens.name: type-strength
tokens.usage: Strength session fill (Legs & Core, Upper Body, Full Body).

tokens.name: type-strength-mark
tokens.usage: Strength dots and marks.

tokens.name: type-recovery
tokens.usage: Mobility, yoga, recovery fill.

tokens.name: type-recovery-mark
tokens.usage: Recovery dots and marks.

tokens.name: plate-red
tokens.usage: PR plate for the marathon (25 kg plate red). White text.

tokens.name: plate-blue
tokens.usage: PR plate for the half marathon (20 kg plate blue). White text.

tokens.name: plate-yellow
tokens.usage: PR plate for 10K (15 kg plate yellow). on-type text.

tokens.name: plate-green
tokens.usage: PR plate for 5K (10 kg plate green). White text, bold 18px+ only.

tokens.name: plate-white
tokens.usage: PR plate for 1K and 1 mile (change plates). on-type text.

tokens.name: plate-rim
tokens.usage: Outer rim and centre hole of every plate badge, so light plates read on light surfaces.

tokens.name: on-plate
tokens.usage: Text on red, blue and green plates.

tokens.name: tier-bronze
tokens.usage: Bronze points tier (0 to 1,999 pts).

tokens.name: tier-silver
tokens.usage: Silver tier (2,000 to 5,999 pts).

tokens.name: tier-gold
tokens.usage: Gold tier (6,000 to 11,999 pts).

tokens.name: tier-platinum
tokens.usage: Platinum tier (12,000 to 19,999 pts).

tokens.name: tier-lime
tokens.usage: Lime tier, the top one (20,000+ pts). The brand colour is the prize.

styles.name: stat-xl
styles.usage: One hero number per screen: race estimate, weekly km on Today.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat blocks, workout distance. Use tabular numerals.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Keep it conversational. You should be able to talk in full sentences.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above stats. Always ink-subtle.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Paces, splits, sets × reps, rest timers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, dot gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips, between progress segments.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on larger cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between screen sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Workout tag squares, segment bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, tiles, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the active tab pill.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only the floating Log workout button and bottom sheets. Cards stay flat.
